title.en: OCBC’s nine-month profit reaches S$6.24bn; insurance weighs on the quarter
title.zh: 华侨银行前九个月净利达62.4亿新元，保险投资拖累单季表现

en: OCBC reported third-quarter net profit of S$2.04bn, up 3% from a year earlier but down 8% from the preceding quarter. Nine-month profit rose 10% to S$6.24bn. The bank attributed the quarterly decline to weaker investment performance at Great Eastern, offsetting record banking-operations profit. Its non-performing-loan ratio was 0.8%.

Our analysis: The headline combines two different trends: banking earnings held up while insurance investment results weakened. Businesses assessing regional credit conditions should look beyond group profit to lending, funding costs and asset quality.
What comes next: Future insurance investment returns and the speed of asset and funding repricing remain uncertain. Watch subsequent margin and credit-quality disclosures.
zh: 华侨银行第三季净利20.4亿新元，同比增3%、环比降8%；前九个月净利同比增10%至62.4亿新元。银行称，大东方投资表现转弱，抵消银行业务创纪录盈利；不良贷款率为0.8%。
原创分析：银行业务与保险投资表现分化，评估区域信贷环境还须观察融资成本和资产质量。下一步关注息差及信贷披露，保险投资回报仍有不确定性。

source.name: Official evidence / 官方依据：OCBC · 3Q26 issuer results release

stories.publicationNote: Released 6 Nov 2026; reporting period July–September and January–September 2026. Singapore. Publication time not stated in the release. 2026年11月6日公布；涵盖第三季度及前九个月，新加坡。公告未注明发布时间。

title.en: Indonesia’s reserves edge higher, with government borrowing among the drivers
title.zh: 印尼外汇储备小幅上升，政府外债提款是驱动因素之一

en: Bank Indonesia put end-October foreign reserves at US$146.8bn, against US$146.3bn in September. It cited government foreign-loan drawdowns and tax and service receipts, alongside debt repayments and rupiah stabilisation. Reserves covered 5.3 months of imports, or 5.2 months including government external-debt service.

Our analysis: A larger reserve stock provides a buffer for external payments, but the funding mix matters. Borrowing-related inflows should be distinguished from recurring export receipts when assessing durability.
What comes next: The release does not quantify each flow’s contribution. Watch later reserve, external-debt and balance-of-payments data before attributing the increase to stronger exports.
zh: 印尼央行公布，10月底外汇储备为1,468亿美元，9月底为1,463亿美元。央行列举政府外债提款、税收及服务收入等因素，同时提到偿债和印尼盾稳定措施；储备可覆盖5.3个月进口。
原创分析：储备增加有助应对外部支付，但借款流入与持续出口收入的性质不同。公告未量化各项贡献，下一步须对照外债及国际收支数据。

source.name: Official evidence / 官方依据：Bank Indonesia · No.28/242/DKom

stories.publicationNote: Released 6 Nov 2026; stock measured at end-October 2026. Jakarta. Page displays 10:00 AM, without an explicit timezone. 2026年11月6日公布；数据时点为10月底，雅加达。页面显示上午10时，未明确时区。

title.en: New-home sales contract even as prices continue to rise slowly
title.zh: 印尼新房销售收缩，房价仍温和上涨

en: Bank Indonesia’s survey showed primary-market residential prices rising 0.58% year on year in Q3, versus 0.69% in Q2. Sales fell 8.43% year on year, with declines across all home types. Internal funds supplied 73.94% of developers’ financing, while mortgages accounted for 70.68% of consumer purchase financing.
Our analysis: Slow price growth can coexist with weak transactions. Developers’ cash collection and mortgage availability may be more useful near-term operating signals than the price index alone.
What comes next: The release does not establish a single cause of weaker sales. Watch the full survey’s regional breakdown and subsequent mortgage and transaction data.
zh: 印尼央行调查显示，第三季一手住宅价格同比升0.58%，低于第二季的0.69%；销售同比降8.43%，各类房屋均下滑。开发商融资中73.94%来自内部资金，消费者购房融资中70.68%为住房贷款。
原创分析：价格微升并不代表交易活跃；开发商回款及按揭可得性值得关注。公告未确定销量下滑的单一原因，下一步观察地区差异和后续交易数据。

source.name: Official evidence / 官方依据：Bank Indonesia · No.28/244/DKom

title.en: Philippine farm and fisheries production value falls 5% in real terms
title.zh: 菲律宾农业及渔业实际产值同比下降5%

en: The Philippine Statistics Authority reported agriculture and fisheries production value of PHP389.42bn at constant 2018 prices in Q3, down 5.0% year on year. It attributed the decline to crops and fisheries; livestock and poultry production values increased.

Our analysis: This is an inflation-adjusted production measure. It signals weaker real output value, but does not directly establish retail food inflation or farm profitability. Food processors and distributors should examine individual commodities and sourcing options.
What comes next: The headline does not isolate weather, disease or price effects on individual businesses. Watch commodity-level tables, food prices and subsequent harvest data.
zh: 菲律宾统计局公布，按2018年不变价格计算，第三季农业及渔业产值为3,894.2亿比索，同比降5%。该局称，作物及渔业产值下降，畜牧和家禽产值则增加。
原创分析：这是剔除价格变动后的产值指标，不能直接等同零售食品涨价或农户利润变化。食品企业须查看分品类供给，下一步关注商品明细和收成数据。

source.name: Official evidence / 官方依据：Philippine Statistics Authority · 2026-359

title.en: Employment rises to 50.32 million; underemployment eases
title.zh: 菲律宾就业人数增至5,032万，就业不足率回落

en: PSA reported 50.32 million employed people in September, compared with 49.79 million in August and 49.60 million a year earlier. Underemployment was 11.0%, against 11.9% in August and 11.1% a year earlier.
Our analysis: The combination points to more people working and a smaller share seeking additional hours. It does not, by itself, show stronger real wages or household purchasing power.
What comes next: The causes of the month-to-month changes are not established by these headline figures. Watch hours worked, sector composition and subsequent survey revisions.
zh: 菲律宾统计局公布，9月就业人数为5,032万，8月为4,979万，上年同期为4,960万。就业不足率为11.0%，低于8月的11.9%及上年同期的11.1%。
原创分析：就业增加、希望增加工时的占比下降，但不能据此判断实际工资或购买力上升。下一步观察工时、行业构成及数据修订。

source.name: Official evidence / 官方依据：Philippine Statistics Authority · September labour-force release

title.en: Cambodia posts official rate of 4,088 riel per US dollar
title.zh: 柬埔寨公布官方汇率：1美元兑4,088瑞尔

en: Cambodia’s General Department of Taxation lists the National Bank of Cambodia’s official rate at KHR4,088 per US dollar for 6 November, compared with KHR4,086 on 5 November.
Our analysis: The change is small. An official reference rate can differ from a bank’s customer quote; this table alone does not demonstrate pressure in the traded currency market.
What comes next: The table does not explain the daily move or provide transaction spreads. Check applicable rates and conversion rules for a specific accounting or commercial use.
zh: 柬埔寨税务总局列示，央行11月6日官方汇率为1美元兑4,088瑞尔，11月5日为4,086瑞尔。
原创分析：变动较小，官方参考汇率可能与银行客户报价不同，不能单凭此表判断市场压力。该表未说明变动原因；实际业务须核实适用换算规则及报价。

source.name: Official evidence / 官方依据：General Department of Taxation · NBC official daily-rate table

stories.publicationNote: Published for 6 Nov 2026; official daily reference, Cambodia. Publication time unavailable. 2026年11月6日官方每日参考汇率，柬埔寨。未注明发布时间。

title.en: Continuing story: Daiso opens a distribution hub in Pulau Indah
title.zh: 持续跟进：大创在雪兰莪州英达岛启用配送中心

en: Malaysia’s Prime Minister’s Office published Anwar Ibrahim’s speech at the opening of Daiso’s global distribution centre in Pulau Indah. The speech described it as Daiso’s largest worldwide and linked the choice to Malaysia’s ports, roads and logistics capabilities. These scale and rationale claims are attributed to the speech.

Our analysis: A distribution hub can generate opportunities for freight, warehousing and local services. Actual commercial benefits depend on cargo volumes and local procurement, which an opening ceremony does not establish.
What comes next: The cited passage does not verify operating throughput, supplier contracts or realised jobs. Seek company operating disclosures before assigning revenue or employment benefits.
zh: 马来西亚首相署发布安华出席大创全球配送中心开幕活动的讲稿。讲稿将英达岛设施称为大创全球最大配送中心，并提及港口、道路及物流能力；这些规模及选址说法均归属于讲稿。
原创分析：项目可能带动货运、仓储及服务需求，但实际收益取决于货量和本地采购。所引内容未核实吞吐量、合同或实际就业，须等待企业运营披露。

source.name: Official evidence / 官方依据：Malaysia Prime Minister’s Office · opening speech
